Page Title: About Project Rebuild
Sub-title: The first ebook launch that pays readers to spread it.

What is Project Rebuild?
Project Rebuild is the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) — The first system that lets indie creators sell unlimited mint NFT ebooks and pay readers real commissions + prize tickets to share them.
Launching with my own raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal," on Base.
And is my public mission to rebuild my family's life after losing millions to a seed-phrase wipeout.

If our FAMM proves itself here, Project Rebuild evolves into BooksOnChain — a community-owned public good platform for every creator.

Built on Cutting-Edge Technology

\- Smart Contracts
Audited, secure Solidity on Base.
\- Chainlink VRF
Provably fair random selection for prize draws.
\- Aave Integration
Yield generation on prize pools via deposits.
\- Base Network
Low fees, fast transactions, Ethereum security.
\- Decentralized
Fully on-chain logic from day one, with initial V1 safeguards.
(evolving to full decentralization with battle-testing)

\- Secure
Industry leading protocols and best practices.

How It Works

Mint Your ebook NFT
Purchase your ebook NFT for $15 USD. Your mint number is your referral code.

Earn Through Referrals
Share your mint number or link. Instantly earn $5 USD every time someone mints using it. No limits, no expiration.
If no code is used → $5 + tickets go to a random existing ticket holder.

Accumulate Tickets
Each referral also gives you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks.
More referrals = more tickets = better chances.

Win Prizes
Small Block: 5 × $500 every 500 sales.
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 every 50,000 sales.
(Sales = mint + secondary)
Winners selected randomly and fairly via Chainlink VRF.

Claim Your Rewards
Commissions sent automatically on-chain. Prizes announced on the Winners page — claim with one click whenever you're ready.

Key Features

Automatic Rewards: Smart contracts handle all payments instantly.
Fair Prize Selection: Chainlink VRF ensures true randomness.
Yield Generation: Prize pools earn yield through Aave integration.
Gamification: Badges and leaderboards make it fun and competitive.
Transparency: All transactions and rules on-chain and verifiable.
Low Fees: Built on Base for speed and minimal transaction costs.

Our Vision
Project Rebuild starts with one book, but this is only the beginning.
We envision a world where ebooks succeed on merit alone, free from the gatekeepers and Amazon algorithms drowning indie voices.
Where creators (unknown or established) rise because their work resonates, not because they game a platform, have the connections or buy enough ads.
Where fans get paid for the word-of-mouth marketing they've always done for free, and where any hustler can jump in to earn if they spot a gem worth spreading.

Our goal: a self-sustaining model that benefits everyone.
Artists earn their fair share, fans & affiliates build real income, communities forge direct bonds — transforming one underdog's recovery into a decentralized revolution for all creators.
All without hype, just aligned incentives.

source_message.text:
Page Title: Our Mission
Sub-title: Building a community driven platform for creators and fans to win together — starting with my rebuild.

Our Purpose
Project Rebuild is more than just an ebook launch — it's a movement to fix what's broken in publishing.
After losing millions to a seed-phrase wipeout, I built a FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) to let creators sell directly and pay fans instant, unlimited commissions + prizes for spreading their work.
Our mission: create a fair and transparent ecosystem where creators and fans are rewarded for their contributions, referrals, and participation — no gatekeepers, no artificial hype.

Community First

We believe in the power of community. Every member's success fuels collective growth, turning individual wins into shared momentum.

Fair Rewards
Transparent, unlimited, on-chain rewards ensure everyone gets what they deserve. No hidden terms, no middlemen.

Innovation
We're pushing NFT, smart contracts, and decentralized technology boundaries. Starting with proving our FAMM and aiming for a full DAO once momentum builds.

Long-Term Vision
Building for sustainability and real impact. We're in it for the long haul, creating lasting value that scales from one underdog story to a platform for all.

What We're Building
Referral Rewards: Earn $5 from everyone you successfully refer to the project. Build the network, grow your rewards.
Prize Pools: Small Block (5 × $500 every 500 sales) and Big Block (5 × $10,000 every 50,000 sales) give referrers a fair shot at big wins via Chainlink VRF randomness.
Gamification: Badges, leaderboards, and achievement create a fun, engaging experience that recognizes and rewards active community members.
Transparency: Everything happens on-chain. Smart contracts ensure fair play and automatic payouts.

Join the Movement
Be part of a community that values your contributions and rewards your success.
